scope: N32 covariance-only technical feasibility pilot combining the completed CF4 marginalized-s1 velocity information spectrum with the frozen 36,635-tracer CF4-disjoint 2M++ selection and Gaussianized-Poisson density Fisher operator.

selection_result.Ksmag_9_lower_cut_reason: The frozen retained sample contains objects brighter than Ksmag=9; applying the ARES example lower cut would be inconsistent with the approved Ksmag<=11.5 population.

warning_audit.message: Astropy divide by zero encountered in log10 while reconstructing catalog distance moduli.
warning_audit.cause: The inherited full-catalog classification evaluates distance modulus before excluding invalid or nonpositive-redshift rows.
warning_audit.effect_on_retained_selection: none observed; all 36,635 retained rows and six population totals passed the frozen finite-selection and normalization gates

scientific_interpretation.primary: The independent 2M++ density tracer materially improves the lowest-bin covariance information relative to velocity alone, but even the most optimistic frozen known-selection/reference-bias scenario reaches only 0.5173 with a numerical lower value of 0.5013, far below 0.8.
scientific_interpretation.joint_frontier: Every scenario has a zero-bin contiguous joint delta-theta prefix under the frozen strict gate.
scientific_interpretation.NO_GO_scope: This is a NO-GO for promoting the N32 parent posterior from this linear Gaussianized-Poisson reference design. It is not a theorem that every possible nonlinear 2M++ likelihood or every additional density tracer must fail.
scientific_interpretation.velocity_covariance_limit: The completed velocity artifact exposes per-bin trace fractions rather than a full posterior covariance, so the velocity term is an isotropic diagonal trace-matched surrogate.
scientific_interpretation.bias_limit: The luminosity-dependent bias vector is a frozen sensitivity reference, not a calibrated physical upper bound; exact bias marginalization is not identifiable at the datum-free homogeneous Fisher point.
scientific_interpretation.nuisance_limit: RSD, FoG, selection-calibration uncertainty, and forward-model discrepancy were not and are not claimed to be marginalized.
scientific_interpretation.resolution: The pilot grid is N32 with 12 cMpc/h cells. No 0.3 cMpc/h observational or numerical resolution claim follows.

recommended_next_stage_requiring_user_ap.name: science_design_after_joint_information_NO_GO
recommended_next_stage_requiring_user_ap.first_action: Audit whether the 0.8 lowest-bin requirement, velocity full-covariance export, and the selected 2M++ population/bias model form the correct parent-posterior decision problem before any field inference.
candidate_directions: Export or recompute the full velocity posterior covariance instead of the isotropic bin-trace surrogate, then repeat only if the approximation can materially change the lowest-bin result.
Calibrate luminosity bias, RSD, FoG, selection uncertainty, and model discrepancy on development mocks and run an honest joint count-likelihood information test.
Add independent density tracers with complementary selection and quantify their incremental Fisher information before attempting a z=0 field posterior.
Do not increase numerical resolution, infer an IC, or start PM/HOP/RAMSES until a parent information gate passes.
